headline.zh: 为机器人训练采集真实任务数据
headline.en: Collect Real Task Data for Robot Training

scenario.zh: 你的仓库机器人需要学习分拣包裹，需要大量真人操作视频来训练模型
scenario.en: Your warehouse robot needs to learn package sorting and requires human operator videos to train the model

instruction.zh: 确定需要机器人学习的具体任务类型
instruction.en: Define the specific task type for robot learning

output.zh: 计划书更新：印度班加罗尔物流中心，100小时第一视角操作录制
output.en: Plan updated: Bangalore logistics center, 100 hours first-person operation recording

output.zh: 计划书更新：孟买餐饮区域，80小时配送员视角数据采集
output.en: Plan updated: Mumbai dining district, 80 hours delivery personnel perspective data collection

instruction.zh: 选择头戴设备的录制参数配置方案
instruction.en: Select recording parameter configuration for headset

output.zh: 配置完成：720p录制，12台设备即日启动，覆盖早晚班次
output.en: Configuration complete: 720p recording, 12 devices start today, covering morning and evening shifts

output.zh: 配置完成：1080p录制，8台设备两天内到位，重点记录手部操作
output.en: Configuration complete: 1080p recording, 8 devices ready in two days, focus on hand operations

instruction.zh: 查看样本片段，确认数据符合训练要求
instruction.en: Review sample clips to confirm data meets training requirements

output.zh: 样本确认：操作者头部移动自然，物体识别清晰，适合模型学习
output.en: Sample confirmed: Natural head movement, clear object recognition, suitable for model learning

output.zh: 现场调整：摄像头下倾15度，重新采集关键分拣动作片段
output.en: On-site adjustment: Camera tilted down 15 degrees, re-collect key sorting action segments

instruction.zh: 选择最终数据集规模和标注深度
instruction.en: Select final dataset scale and annotation depth

output.zh: 数据集就绪：60小时有效片段，物体边界框标注，可立即开始训练
output.en: Dataset ready: 60 hours valid clips, object bounding boxes annotated, training can start immediately

output.zh: 数据集就绪：45小时高质量片段，手部关键点与动作序列标注完整
output.en: Dataset ready: 45 hours high-quality clips, hand keypoints and action sequences fully annotated

takeaway.zh: 真实任务视角数据帮助机器人学习人类操作模式，加速实际场景部署能力
takeaway.en: Real task perspective data helps robots learn human operation patterns and accelerates real-world deployment capability
